scope: Finite seed catalog of first-party analyst pages and existing Film Room written evidence; not a complete index of online football analysis.
limitations: No videos were watched or audio transcripts reviewed in this edition. Metadata-reviewed sources contribute discovery and match candidates, not verified analyst action claims.
Exact-game identifies a game, not an exact snap. Candidate selectors must match one persisted source play before a canonicalPlayId may be assigned.
A text-verified claim means the attributed statement was read; it does not turn analyst interpretation into measured tracking or establish every off-camera assignment.
Links and short original-language paraphrases are retained. No videos, images or wholesale transcripts are redistributed. Public accessibility does not determine reuse rights.
